t2.thesis: The bar for the second half is high: full-year comparable sales guidance of 6.5-7.5% against 4.3% in the first half implies roughly 9-10% in H2, and ABT's recent prints have mostly drawn negative opening reactions, so the odds lean slightly toward a lower exit open.
reasons: The full-year comparable sales guide (6.5-7.5%) needs a sharp H2 acceleration from 4.3% in H1, so a trim or a miss on comparable growth is a real risk (I4).
Three of the last four prints opened lower (-2.2%, -11.7%, -3.6%), even on in-line or small beats; only the guidance-raise quarter rose (I2).
Nutrition (-3.6%) and Rapid/Molecular diagnostics (-8%) are still drags, and the respiratory season is weak (I4, I5).
Consensus EPS of $1.415 sits at the midpoint of the $1.38-1.46 guide, with flat revisions, so there is no low bar to beat (I2).
Partial offset: the stock is 18% below its 52-week high, has a 17x forward P/E, and is up 3.1% in five days. The low valuation could cushion a reaction, but the run-up adds sell-the-news risk.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether Abbott holds the full-year comparable sales guide of 6.5-7.5% and EPS of $5.45-5.60, and whether Q3 comparable growth shows the promised acceleration (high single digits).

t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 7 points from 0.54: about -4 for the demanding implied H2 comparable sales acceleration and guidance risk, about -3 for ABT's recent negative reaction pattern. I add back about +1 for the depressed valuation and the guidance-raise precedent from July.

theses.mechanism: Q3 comparable growth comes in mid-single digits and full-year sales guidance is trimmed to the low end or cut, weighed down by Nutrition and Diagnostics
theses.wrong_if: Q3 comparable sales are 8% or more and the full-year range is reaffirmed

theses.mechanism: Acceleration materializes through devices (EP, CGM, Aveir) plus Cologuard, and the EPS guide is raised again, repeating July's +8% reaction
theses.wrong_if: The EPS raise is only a narrowing toward the midpoint, or Q4 implied guidance falls short of consensus

theses.mechanism: An in-line EPS print near $1.42 meets reaffirmed guidance; the 5-day run-up fades and the open drifts within ±2%
theses.wrong_if: There is a material surprise in sales guidance or in CGM/Libre growth

key_observations: Q3 comparable sales growth versus the roughly 9% needed for H2
Full-year comparable sales and EPS guidance: raise, reaffirm, narrow or cut
Q4 EPS implied by the guide versus consensus
CGM/Libre growth rate and Electrophysiology growth
Nutrition stabilization and Cologuard growth; any comments on NEC litigation reserves
